item.title: Josh Groban to Get ‘Closer’ to His Fans With a Star on Hollywood Walk of Fame
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in the entertainment world. Today, we're shining the spotlight on the talented Josh Groban. Get ready for an exciting update on his latest achievements and upcoming projects."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Josh Groban is set to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on May 6th, and it's going to be a big day for him. Not only will he be honored with the 2,843rd star, but he'll also be performing at the Grammy Hall of Fame Gala that night, where his record company, Warner Records, is being recognized. And if that's not enough, his new album, Cinematic, drops just two days later."
[Music transitions]
Host: "The star ceremony will take place at 11:30 am PT on May 6th, in front of Amoeba Records on Hollywood Boulevard. You can catch the live stream at walkoffame.com. Groban will be joined by friends David Foster, Josh Gad, and Ben Schwartz, who will speak at the ceremony. Ellen K, an iHeart Media personality, will emcee the event."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Groban's new album, Cinematic, is a collection of film songs, including tracks from The Godfather, Casablanca, and Breakfast at Tiffany's. With three No. 1 albums on the Billboard 200 and five Grammy nominations, Groban is no stranger to success. And with this new album, he may be back in contention for more awards."
[Music transitions]
Host: "But that's not all - Groban has a busy schedule ahead. He'll be touring North America with special guest Jennifer Hudson in June and returning to The Colosseum at Caesars Palace for his Las Vegas residency in the fall. And, as an arts education philanthropist, he continues to support his Find Your Light Foundation, which enriches the lives of young students through arts and cultural awareness."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Congratulations to Josh Groban on his well-deserved star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. We can't wait to see what's next for this talented artist. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
